_comment: Classification rules, derived from 7 months of Chase statements (Dec 2025 - Jul 2026).
Edit this file to change behaviour; the logic never hardcodes any of it.
All amounts are in integer CENTS. All match strings are lowercased substrings
tested against the normalized description (punctuation, reference numbers and
embedded dates stripped - see src/normalize.ts).
Precedence, highest first: manual override > exclude > essential > subscription
> bill pattern > income > discretionary.

allowance._comment: Friday paycheck. Pay week runs Friday through Thursday, paid the following Friday.

incomeBaseline._comment: Seeds from 7 months of statements. Recomputed from real data once enough history exists.

subscriptions.name: Claude Code Max
subscriptions._comment: Matched on merchant alone. Real charges have been 5.49, 21.95, 88.30, 91.08 and 109.75 - a fixed-amount rule missed six of nine. Billing day per Walid is the 1st.

subscriptions.name: Netflix
subscriptions._comment: Real charges: 19.74, 27.43, 37.30, 40.58 as the plan changed. Amount is not a reliable signal.

subscriptions.name: Planet Fitness
subscriptions._comment: Real charges include a 4.39 fee and a 53.78 double month.

subscriptions.name: Amazon Prime
subscriptions._comment: Matches 'amazon prime' specifically, never bare 'amazon' - ordinary Amazon shopping must stay discretionary. Real charge is 8.22, not 8.67.

subscriptions.name: Google Workspace
subscriptions._comment: NOT SEEN in seven months of statements. Left in place in case it bills elsewhere; it will read 'never seen'.

subscriptions.name: Google *Niagara
subscriptions._comment: Real charge 2026-07-08. Distinct from the Microsoft Store charge that is also 15.35.

subscriptions.name: Apple
subscriptions._comment: Recurring 0.99 found in the statements but never mentioned - added so it stops landing in discretionary. Delete this entry if it is not yours. Amount-checked on purpose: Apple.Com/Bill also carries App Store purchases and hardware, and with variableAmount a $1,299 MacBook would have read as this $0.99 subscription and vanished out of spending.

essentials.name: Car insurance + phone
essentials._comment: Every Zelle to Dad is this commitment regardless of amount (confirmed 2026-08-11). Real amounts have ranged $16.64 to $365.

essentials.name: Debt repayment
essentials._comment: Statements say 'Zelle Payment To Walid <ref>' with NO surname. The old rule looked for 'walid elsayed' and therefore never matched a single one of the five real $280 payments.

essentials.name: Fiqh class (Daris)
essentials._comment: Any Wise transfer. Real amounts vary: 40, 41, 59, 88.50, 99.

billPatterns._comment: Outgoing charges that count as bills rather than discretionary. Klarna/Zip are buy-now-pay-later, same idea as Affirm.

neverSubscription._comment: Recurring-looking charges that must never be reported as subscriptions. They still count as discretionary spending.

_comment: Neither income nor spending.
Outgoing Zelles to yourself are either the $280 debt repayment or money moved
for the Friday paycheck (confirmed 2026-08-11), so they are excluded here.
Essentials are matched BEFORE exclusions, which is what lets the $280 debt
repayment still register while every other self-payment is ignored.
Applies to positive amounts only. exclude wins over include.
Transfers between my own accounts are NOT listed here - they live in
exclude.patterns above, so they are ignored whichever direction they run.
What remains here is credits that are real but are not earnings: a credit
matching one of these nets against discretionary spending if it can be
traced back to a purchase, and is otherwise left out of the maths.

grouping._comment: Charges from the same merchant within this many days read as one payment, not several subscriptions.

_comment: A credit that is not income nets against discretionary spending instead of
counting as earnings. If it lands in a later week than the purchase it is
matched back to the original charge by merchant and amount.
